matrix_blind_strategy: Sort each displayed coordinate set in row-major coordinate order, sort the five sets lexicographically, select the third. Ignore the matrix and displayed radio position.
construction: Each distractor chooses lower versus upper pool with probability 1/2. Both sides remain nonempty through all four draws. Key is the median exactly when two distractors are below and two above.
limits: Statistical leakage, not a universal answer or a guarantee for every matrix. Exact 3/8 construction statement is conditional on both side pools initially containing at least four distractors.
